about.text: A black, highly acidic dairy product of Iran, Afghanistan and Central Asia, made by boiling down the sour whey left from making kashk, or qurut, until it thickens, then drying it until brittle.

links.name: Wikipedia: Qaraqorut (citing Walker, Milk – Beyond the Dairy, 1999)

how.text: Boiling down the sour, lactic-acid-rich whey concentrates its acid and sugars until the mass darkens, and drying then leaves a black, brittle, very sour block.

steps.note: Some fresh milk is added to the sour whey left from straining kashk.
Poured onto a tray and dried until brittle.
